analysis.title: GS Special Situations | Morning Trading Update (Topical Situations: LITE/MRVL/VAL/RIG/ROKU/FOXA)
key_insights: LITE/MRVL: Bloomberg reported Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang gave his blessing to the Marvell and Lumentum CEOs before their roughly $103bn combination. The spread closed the prior day a little over 12.5% gross, 9% annualized IRR to a 4/1/28 close.
VAL/RIG: Valaris confirmed required regulatory approvals have been received for its combination with Transocean and guided to a close on or about December 1, 2026.
ROKU/FOXA closed the prior day with 84bps of gross spread left after the companies announced all ex-US regulatory approvals were received.

ON reported 3Q revenue of $1.72bn, in line with GS and the Street ($1.71bn). Industrial revenue of $467mn was well above GS ($423mn) and the Street ($426mn), while Automotive revenue of $777mn was below GS ($820mn) and the Street ($809mn).
ON disclosed AI Data Center revenue for the first time, at $180mn in 3Q.
October merger arb spreads tightened by 30bps on average and 70bps on a market-cap-weighted basis. Both metrics are +4% YTD.
The merger arb spread pool finished October at about $24bn, up 16% from September, driven by two large deal announcements: CART ($2.1bn spread opportunity) and PTC ($1bn spread).
M&A activity remains active heading into November per the desk.

ON segment revenue reported: Automotive $777mn (GS est $820mn, Street est $809mn), Industrial $467mn (GS est $423mn, Street est $426mn), Datacenter/Other $479mn (GS est $477mn, Street est $473mn).
